 News School Holiday November 20, 2026? Will Schools Remain Closed on Friday? Check State-Wise Updates
 By Pratyasha Chaturvedi Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 20:34 IST School Holiday November 20, 2026: Check the state-wise school closure updates for Rajasthan, Odisha, West Bengal, and other states in the article below.
 School Holiday November 20, 2026 Register for Result Updates Key Points
 No nationwide school holiday announced for November 20, 2026, across India.
 Odisha schools in 9 districts closed Nov 19-21, 2026, due to Cyclone Akvan.
 Holiday status varies by state, parents must check local school notifications.
 School students across India are looking forward to the upcoming weekend, with several states continuing their scheduled Diwali vacations and regional school breaks in November 2026. As Friday, November 20, approaches, students and parents are checking whether schools will remain closed or operate as usual. November 20, 2026, falls on a Friday. While there is no nationwide school holiday announced for this date, students in some states may continue to enjoy their scheduled festive vacations. The holiday status will depend on state education department instructions, regional celebrations and individual school calendars. 
 School Holiday November 20, 2026: State-Wise Updates 
 Here is a look at the expected school holiday status across different states on November 20, 2026:- 
 State 
 Reason for Holiday 
 Delhi 
 Schools across Delhi are expected to remain open on November 20, 2026. There is no official order announcing any citywide school holiday. 
 With the revocation of the GRAP-Stage III restrictions, schools in Delhi have also resumed offline classes. 
 Parents are advised to check the official groups or notices regarding any last-minute changes in view of the air pollution.  
 Tamil Nadu 
 Schools in Tamil Nadu are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, 2026, and no statewide school holiday announcement has been made. 
 However, the districts affected by the upcoming cyclone Akvan and affected by heavy rainfall may announce local closure depending on weather conditions and instructions as deemed fit by the district collectorate. 
 Parents are advised to keep checking the official groups and notifications for any update on the school holiday. 
 Bihar 
 Schools across Bihar are expected to remain open on November 20, 2026; no announcement has been made related to a school holiday in the state of Bihar. 
 The extended holiday for Delhi and Chhath Puja has also ended, and schools are expected to resume their regular academic activities. 
 Odisha 
 In around nine districts of Odisha, schools have been ordered to remain closed on November 20, 2026. This step has been taken as a precautionary measure against Cyclone Akvan.  
 The state government jas announced holidays for all government, government-aided and private schools in Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara and Kandhamal, Malkangiri, Rayagada and Koraput districts, which will remain closed from November 19 to 21, 2026.  
 Himachal Pradesh 
 Himachal Pradesh Schools are expected to remain open on November 20, 2026. 
 As per the gazetted holiday calendar, there is no holiday listed for November 20, 2026, in Himachal Pradesh. 
 Rajasthan 
 Rajasthan Schools are to remain open on November 20, 2026. There is no statewide school holiday announced for the day.  
 The term vacation, which was observed from November 4 to November 15, has also ended, and regular classes have resumed from November 16, 2026. 
 West Bengal 
 Schools are expected to remain open on November 20, 2026. No official announcement regarding the closure of schools has been made. 
 However, there is a chance that private, CBSE- and ICSE-affiliated schools may follow a different academic schedule. 
 Will Schools Remain Closed on November 20, 2026? 
 There is no common school holiday which is applicable across India on November 20, 2026. Schools in states like Odisha are closed due to Cyclone Akvan, while schools in other states will remain open and resume regular classes on Friday. Parents and students are advised to check the latest school circulars, official education department notifications and district administration announcements before making holiday-related plans. Private, government, CBSE and ICSE schools may follow different academic calendars.
